installFfmpeg.title: Install ffmpeg (Docker only)
installFfmpeg.description: Docker only: install ffmpeg automatically if it is not found in the container. Ignored on the other installations, where ffmpeg must be installed manually.

discoverWebcams.title: Discover webcams
discoverWebcams.description: Discover the webcams available on this system and add them to the webcams list.

webcams.title: Webcams
webcams.description: Define each webcam. Enter in the first field the name of the webcam (replace newKey with the name of the webcam) and in the right panel the video and audio sources.

videoSource.title: Video Source
videoSource.description: The ffmpeg video source: the device name on macOS (avfoundation) and Windows (dshow), the device path (i.e. /dev/video0) on Linux (v4l2).

audioSource.title: Audio Source
audioSource.description: The ffmpeg audio source: the microphone name on macOS and Windows. Leave empty for no audio. Not used on Linux.

play.description: Play the webcam in an ffplay window

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable the debug for the plugin (development only)

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
